resources.string: Won means the hands you won matched your prediction. Earn 10 + predicted hands, including zero. Lost earns 0.\n\nPredict 0 and win 0 → 10 points. Predict 3 and win 3 → 13 points.

Won with zero hands earns 7 points. Any other Won earns 10 + predicted hands. Lost earns 0.\n\nFor a matched prediction above half the hands in the round, add the round’s hand count, up to 10 bonus points. Exactly half earns no bonus. Only the bonus is capped at 10; the total round score is not capped.
Won with zero hands earns %1$d points. Any other Won earns %2$d + (%3$d × predicted hands). Lost earns 0.
A matched prediction above half the hands in the round earns a majority bonus: the round’s hand count, up to 10 points. Exactly half earns no bonus. Only the bonus is capped at 10.
Choose points for Won with zero hands, base points for any other Won, and points per predicted hand. Lost always earns 0. The optional majority bonus follows Aggressive rules.
